contexts.text: The faith of charity is the truth of doctrine adjoined to the good of life.
By truths of doctrine conjoined with good of life, man become spiritual.
See Free.
The good of life, or the affection of good, is insinuated by the Lord through an internal way, quite unknown to the man...
When love to the Lord and charity towards the neighbour, that is, the good of life, is the essential, Churches make one. AC 6269:2.
This trust is impossible except in the good of life; without the good of life there is no reception...
For everyone is gifted with a lot in the other life according to the good of life...
The natural good of life of truth. Signified, Explained.
The good of life of natural truth is what is represented by Esau.
The good of life from sensuous and scientific truths. Signified, Explained.
The good of life from doctrinal things. Signified, Explained.

The Church is not the Church from doctrinal things, except in so far as they regard the good of life as an end; or, what is the same, unless the doctrinal things are conjoined with the good of life; and therefore by a field is principally signified the good of life...
Without doctrinal things there is indeed the good of life, but not as yet the good of the Church... as is the case with the good of life with the gentiles...
Esau, here, = ... the good of life from influx from the Rational.
The good of life gifted with the good of truth, and with the good of doctrinal things. Signified, Explained.

At last he lives according to them, which is the good of life. Thus does the spiritual man, when being regenerated, proceed from the doctrine of truth to the good of life. When, however, he is in the good of life, the order is inverted...

That these goods; namely, the good of life, the good of truth, and the good of doctrinal things, are distinct from each other, may be evident to those who consider: the good of life is that which flows forth from the will; the good of truth from the understanding; and the good of doctrinal things from knowledge.
That meanwhile the good of life made no account of the priority. Signified, Explained.
Thus the affection of good, or, what is the same, the good of life, begins to have dominion. It had the dominion before, but this could not appear to the man...

They who are... not in the good of life cannot but be in persuasive faith... But in proportion as anyone is in the good of life, that is, in love to the Lord and in charity towards the neighbour, he is in intelligence, that is, in faith from the Lord...
With those who are not in the good of life, the falsities which they have hatched by a wrong interpretation of the Word, keep in the middle or centre, and truths in the circumference...
The affection of natural good, or the good of life. Signified, Explained.
That the affection of good, and the derivative good of life, is the elder son. Explained.
For whatever is imbued from infancy puts on life, and as it remains permanently, it becomes the good of life.
The good of infancy and the derivative good of life is the first of regeneration.
The man is then not only affected with truth... but still more with the good of life itself.
Not all the things which the soul introduces are such as to become the good of life...

In his fourth age, which is the age of his regeneration... the man loves the Word and the doctrinal things which are from it... for the sake of the good of life; and therefore from the good of life. Thus does good become in the first place...
God hath judged me... = ... in the external sense, the good of life.
For the Holy of faith corresponds to the good of life.
Under Daniel, see this reference. AC 4608. AC 6024:6. AC 6396.
Still, they who are in the good of Life, that is, who live in love to God and in charity towards the neighbour, are saved. Explained.
No one can be regenerated except through the good of life conjoined with the truth of doctrine. Signified... Water = the truth of doctrine; and spirit, the good of life.
For they who are in the good of life, that is, who love the Lord and the neighbour, love the truths of faith...
In both externals and internals are all those who are in the good of life according to the doctrinal things of their Church...

In the Spiritual Church... there are two kinds of men; there are those who are in the truth of faith and not in the corresponding good of life; and there are those who are in the good of charity and the corresponding truth of faith. (The latter) are men of the Internal Church; and are called the sons of Israel... But (the former) are men of the External Spiritual Church; and are meant by the Hebrew servants.
That then are implanted truths of doctrine and goods of life, and through them the man of the Church is regenerated by the Lord. Treated of.
To be instructed about the good of life, but not to live in it. Signified.
Introduction into Heaven by Him according to the good of life and of faith. Signified, Explained.
They who receive (the light of Divine truth) are they who are in the good of life...
Therefore they who are in the good of life from the truths of faith receive (the influx of the Lord).
By good is meant the good of life; and the good of life is to do good from willing good...
In proportion as (the gentiles) have been in the good of life, they worship Him from faith and love.
All within the Church who are in the good of life acknowledge the Divine in the Word. Explained... It is otherwise with those who are not in the good of life; with them the internal... is closed.
Under Falsity, see this reference.
The good of life regarded as only a moral accessory for the public good.
The evil of life interiorly hates truths, but the good of life interiorly loves truths.
That everyone acknowledges God, and is conjoined with Him, according to the good of his life. Explained.
That the good of life, or to live well, is to shun evils because they are contrary to religion, thus contrary to God. Explained.
The things which are revealed by the Lord through Heaven to those who are in the good of life from charity and its faith. Signified, Explained.
Truth in act and work, which is the good of life... is the first and primary of the Church. Explained. AR 17:4.
Therefore the good of life is now taught by the Lord for those who will be of His New Church...
Levi = truth in act, which is the good of life: and therefore the priesthood was given to his posterity.
The inversion of the state of those who are in the good of life, as to the perception of truth in the Word, when they turn to the Lord. Signified, Explained.
To those and concerning those who primarily regard truths of doctrine and not goods of life. Signified, Explained.
That this is against them, that they have not the goods of life in the first place; yet this has been done and is done at the beginning of every Church. Signified, Explained.

In proportion as a man is in goods of life, he is really in truths of doctrine... The reason is that goods of life open the interiors of the mind; and when these are open truths appear in their own light; from which they are not only understood, but are also loved...
As the Church declines, it begins to regard truths of doctrine in the first place, and goods of life in the second.

He who is being regenerated, after he has imbued the truths of faith, regards the goods of life in the first place; and in proportion as he does this, he ripens like fruit; and in proportion as he ripens, the seed in him becomes prolific...
To those and concerning those who are in goods as to life, but in falsities as to doctrine. Signified, Explained. AR 98. AR 99.
As to life they are in goods, which they believe to be goods of life, when yet they are not.
The good of life with those who will be of the Lord's New Heaven and New Church. Signified, Explained.
The meritorious good of life. Signified.
The good of life is not religion where there is faith alone.
That through truths from the Word there are goods of life with those who are of the Lord's Church. Signified, Explained.

There are two things which make the Church... with man, the truth of faith and the good of life; the truth of faith makes the Lord's presence, and the good of life according to the truths of faith makes conjunction with Him... Explained. AE 440:2.
Occurs. SE 5708:end. SE 5916. SE 6004:3. DMin 4624.
The Lord's Church is... with all who are in the good of life, and from their doctrine look to Heaven...
The desire for Knowledges of truth and good is the spiritual affection of truth, which is possible only with those who are in the good of life; that is, who do the Lord's precepts.
Under Fig, see this reference.
Under Gad, see this reference. AE 435:4. AE 435:5. AE 435:7. AE 435:9. AE 436.
See Good of Love. AE 435:3.
Under Manasseh, see this reference.
That which the will of a regenerate man does is called the good of life.
By Simeon is signified truth in the will, which is the good of life.

All who are in the good of life according to their religion, in which are not genuine truths. Signified, Explained... These undergo temptations in the other life, by which the falsities of their religion are dispelled, and genuine truths are implanted in their place.
On those who are in falsities from ignorance, and in the good of Life. References.
For the good of life according to religion stores up in itself the affection of knowing truths...
In the good of life according to truths. Signified, Explained.
The good of truth, when it is with anyone, is the good of life. Explained.
(Thus) all the good which is good with man, is the good of life.

To be in the good of life according to their religion does indeed save them; but it does not save them so long as they are in falsities; and therefore after their life in the world the falsities with them are removed. (Explained.)

For the essential in Heaven is the good of life, which is the same as the good of love to the Lord and the good of charity towards the neighbour; for according to this good everyone there has perception of truth, intelligence, and wisdom.
Cast the net on the right side of the vessel = that they should teach the good of life.

Wilderness also = the state of the Church with the gentiles, who have been in ignorance of truth, and still in the good of life according to their religion, from which they have longed for truths. Explained, Illustrated.
They are in the ultimates of Heaven who are in falsities from doctrine and religion, and still in the good of life...
By the disciples following Jesus are signified the goods of life, which are good works...
Occurs. LJPost 227.
